objects.name: How Adversaries Are Turning the Vulnerability Ecosystem Against Defenders
objects.description: Threat actors are exploiting the four-flaw chain to hack the Plex Media Server application on QNAP NAS devices. The post Plex2Shell Exploited Against QNAP NAS Users appeared first on SecurityWeek .
